title: Millions of Americans are not taking their GLP-1 drugs as prescribed
summary: Cost and access barriers are pushing people to modified use and unapproved versions.
llm_summary: Millions of Americans are skipping doses, splitting pens, or buying cheap, unapproved versions of GLP‑1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy because the high out‑of‑pocket costs and limited insurance coverage make the prescribed regimen unaffordable. These workarounds not only reduce the drugs’ effectiveness but also raise safety concerns, highlighting a broader tech‑driven challenge: how to use data, digital pharmacy tools and supply‑chain
